title: Aurora DSQL coverage
intro: Every Aurora DSQL operation the emulator advertises, and what Emuplane does with
it. The API is REST-JSON routed on method + path and signed with the `dsql`
credential scope; there is no console action.
Unless `DSQL_STRICT=1` and Docker are available, a cluster is metadata-only and
`ACTIVE` at creation — nothing listens on its port — so the tests need no
backend. Cluster policies carry a version; a CDC stream targets a Kinesis stream,
which the test creates under the `kinesis` scope, and with `AUTH=true` the target
role must exist in IAM, so the test creates that too. Nothing is delivered to the
